known_gaps.measured: Measured 2026-11-15 on v0.28.0: the reader breaks this sentence across four lines with hyphens, so the flattened form an author would retype matches at similarity 0.91 and the tier is `fuzzy`; the run reports `quote-fuzzy` at high and the claim is counted missing. The demo passes because it quotes the reader's own line-broken text, which matches exactly. An author who retypes the printed sentence is told the quote is only approximate. Closing this means teaching the hyphen tier to absorb a whole sentence's worth of line breaks, which is a matching change and needs its own accepted design.
